proposed_train_metadata.confidence_note: Candidate horn status is absent_observed. FFT analysis of 16kHz audio from both streams shows low-frequency engine dominance (82-94 Hz) and absence of pneumatic horn spectral peaks (300-800 Hz). In accordance with protocol, the human researcher must listen to the original audio tracks throughout the relevant interval before final approval. Candidate trailing vehicle count of 7 passenger coaches is traceable in sequential frames (Coach 1 dining car #6601, Coaches 2-5 passenger cars, Coach 6 #6501, Coach 7 final car).

T0_first_visible.rationale: Candidate first observed train frame in available recording (Frame 0). Left-censored: locomotive #2933 is already visible approaching under the flyover at recording start, so true physical visual arrival occurred at t <= 0.00s. True physical onset and true detection latency are unmeasured and subject to researcher adjudication.

T1_danger_zone_entry.rationale: Provisional candidate: locomotive cowcatcher reaches the turnout switch frog where foreground pedestrian path crosses tracks. Under Prerequisite R03, physical crossing danger-zone survey boundaries remain uncertified; this timestamp reflects observed frog landmark traversal, not a surveyed road boundary.

T2_crossing_occupancy_start.rationale: Provisional candidate: locomotive pilot passes the front camera lens plane. Under Prerequisite R03, the formal road boundary of the crossing is uncertified; this timestamp is based purely on the camera transverse plane landmark, pending human confirmation of the physical crossing boundary. Acoustic engine rumble peak is not used as ground-truth substitution.

T3_locomotive_exit.rationale: Provisional candidate: rear coupler/trailing edge of lead locomotive #2933 clears the vegetable vendor cart line, transitioning to dining car #6601. Note naming conflict: Ground Truth Protocol v5.0.0 §2.1 labels T3 'Locomotive Head Exit' while physically defining it as 'trailing edge of the leading locomotive(s) exits'. Approval is paused pending researcher terminology confirmation.

T4_tail_clearance.rationale: Provisional candidate: rear buffer/diaphragm of the 7th coach clears the vegetable cart / pedestrian crossing surge line. Under Prerequisite R03, formal crossing roadway exit boundary is uncertified; landmark reflects observed cart line and pedestrian crossing initiation.

T_scene_clear.rationale: Unobservable: back camera recording terminates at 46.065s while receding train remains clearly visible in frame under metro flyover.

proposed_camera_alignment_markers.candidate_front_marker: Locomotive front reaches camera plane at t=6.50s (front timeline)
proposed_camera_alignment_markers.candidate_back_marker: Locomotive nose enters back camera view at t~0.80s (back timeline)
proposed_camera_alignment_markers.stream_exposure_note: Combined camera-stream exposure (120.788s) represents summed stream-seconds and must NOT be treated as concurrent wall-clock exposure. R03 and R04 remain uncertified.
